workspace:scorecard.description: Scorecard is a local code-quality gate that runs project checks and reports results for people, agents, and CI.

app:sc-cli:sc.description: Runs Scorecard analysis and prints a human-readable or machine-readable report.

module:sc-cli:crate root.description: CLI for the `sc` scorecard gate. User-facing analyze output is the scorecard, rendered as JSON and/or Markdown.

module:sc-cli:crate root::format.description: Formats scorecards as JSON and Markdown, including their findings and project summary.

module:sc-cli:crate root::pretty.description: Human-readable scorecard for a terminal. Color follows `NO_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR_FORCE`, and whether stdout is a TTY. The plain style uses ASCII so a captured transcript stays readable.

module:sc-cli:crate root::report.description: Self-contained HTML scorecard report. `to_html` renders one `.html` file with inline CSS and no external requests, so it works from `file://` and from any static server. It mirrors the linear-flow visual language: pipeline strip, in/out chips, terminal-styled runs, and pass/fail pills.

module:sc-cli:crate root::setup.description: Install the agent skill and register the `sc-mcp` server.

cargo-feature:sc-cli:default.description: Uses the default compile-time feature set declared for the sc command.

module:sc-core:crate root.description: Scorecard contract, configuration, and score formulas.

module:sc-core:crate root::config.description: `analyzer.toml` loading. Search order: `--config`, then `./analyzer.toml` in the project, then `~/.config/sc/analyzer.toml`.

module:sc-core:crate root::model.description: JSON contract. Field names are part of the stable scorecard schema.

module:sc-core:crate root::score.description: Dimension scores and the CRAP formula. Dimension scores are in `0.0..=1.0`. Each score starts at 1.0.

crate:sc-engines.description: Deterministic compile, test, coverage, and CRAP engines

module:sc-engines:crate root.description: Deterministic engines. They return findings and never print diagnostics.

module:sc-engines:crate root::a11y.description: Static accessibility checks mapped to WCAG 2.2 success criteria. HTML comes from the web pack. JSX and TSX come from the node pack.

module:sc-engines:crate root::cargo_test.description: Runs Cargo tests and turns process results into scorecard findings. It also selects targeted Rust tests when the project supports them.

module:sc-engines:crate root::command.description: Runs external commands with time limits and captures their output and failure details.

module:sc-engines:crate root::compile.description: Runs project compilation and maps compiler diagnostics into scorecard findings.

module:sc-engines:crate root::coverage.description: Function line coverage from `cargo llvm-cov --workspace --json`. Names are demangled and crate disambiguator hashes are stripped, then matched to syn symbols. A miss means coverage was not measured for that function.

module:sc-engines:crate root::crap.description: Compares function complexity with measured test coverage and reports CRAP scores.

module:sc-engines:crate root::facts.description: Collects project source facts and cache keys for repeatable engine runs.

module:sc-engines:crate root::html_doc.description: HTML document parse for the web pack. `html5ever` builds the tree and reports parse errors with the current line. A separate tag stack reports unclosed and misnested tags, because the HTML parser closes many of those for you.

module:sc-engines:crate root::links.description: Internal link check. No network requests.

module:sc-engines:crate root::manifest.description: Reads package manifests to resolve workspace ownership and declared dependencies.

module:sc-engines:crate root::mutation.description: Runs mutation checks and summarizes which source changes the project's tests detected.

module:sc-engines:crate root::pack.description: Language pack detection. One marker selects a pack. Several markers stay ambiguous unless only one of them has source files.

module:sc-engines:crate root::pack_cov.description: Line coverage reports for the non-Rust packs. Each parser returns statement hits inside a function span. Missing reports leave those functions without a CRAP row.

module:sc-engines:crate root::pipeline.description: Assemble a scorecard from the deterministic engines. Engines return structured findings. Nothing in this crate writes user-facing diagnostics; the CLI formats the scorecard.

module:sc-engines:crate root::poly_cc.description: Cyclomatic complexity for the non-Rust packs. Python uses the stdlib `ast` module. The other packs count decision points in each function body.

module:sc-engines:crate root::python.description: Python pack: compile, pytest, Ruff, and imports checked against pyproject.toml. A local module is not a finding. An installed or published import missing from pyproject is an undeclared dependency.

module:sc-engines:crate root::rust_toolc.description: Choose how Cargo commands pick a rustup toolchain. - `analyzer.toml` `toolchain` sets `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN` to that channel. - A `rust-toolchain.toml` / `rust-toolchain` at or above the project clears an inherited `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN` so rustup reads the file (channel, components, targets, profile). - Otherwise the inherited environment is left alone.

module:sc-engines:crate root::scope.description: Selects the files and packages included in an analysis run according to project scope rules.

module:sc-engines:crate root::secrets.description: Scans project text for supported credential patterns and emits security findings.

module:sc-engines:crate root::spec_check.description: Compares stated requirements with source and file evidence to report possible specification gaps.

module:sc-engines:crate root::toolchain.description: Compile, test, and lint commands for the non-Rust, non-Python packs. A missing compiler is reported and does not fail the process. A command that runs is enforced.

crate:sc-graph.description: Rust source discovery and cyclomatic complexity

module:sc-graph:crate root.description: Source discovery and cyclomatic complexity. Complexity is McCabe cyclomatic complexity, not cognitive complexity. Macros are not expanded.

module:sc-graph:crate root::complexity.description: Parses Rust items and calculates cyclomatic complexity for functions and closures.

module:sc-graph:crate root::discover.description: Walks project files to find source code while applying ignore, generated-file, and scope rules.

module:sc-graph:crate root::imports.description: Reads source import paths and local names for dependency checks.

module:sc-graph:crate root::perf.description: Performance hints. Off by default (`engines.perf = false`). When enabled, a nested loop and a `.clone()` inside a loop are `perf.*` findings (disposition `ignore`).

module:sc-graph:crate root::pubs.description: Collects public item declarations from Rust source files.

module:sc-graph:crate root::walk.description: Directories Scorecard leaves out by default. Dot-directories are also skipped, except the generated and dependency directories listed here can be included with `scope.include_generated`.

module:sc-llm:crate root.description: Optional spec-gap review over an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. The built-in default endpoint is local Ollama. When `XAI_API_KEY` is set and the endpoint is still that default, the call uses SpaceXAI (`https://api.x.ai/v1`, model `grok-4.5`).

app:sc-mcp:sc-mcp.description: Exposes Scorecard analysis tools through an MCP server.

module:sc-mcp:crate root.description: MCP server for four scorecard tools. `analyze_paths`, `analyze_diff`, `explain`, and `list_findings`. There is no chat tool.

crate:sc-mutation.description: Workspace marker. The mutation runner lives in sc-engines.

module:sc-mutation:crate root.description: The mutation runner lives in `sc-engines`. This crate remains so the workspace layout stays in place.

features.label: Quality gate
features.description: The sc command assembles engine findings into a scorecard with enforced and advisory gates.

features.label: Source analysis
features.description: Source discovery, imports, public items, and complexity analysis feed the project facts used by the engines.

features.label: Tests and coverage
features.description: The engines run project tests, collect line coverage, and compare coverage with function complexity.

features.label: Security checks
features.description: The secrets engine scans project files for supported credential patterns and reports findings through the scorecard.

features.label: Language packs
features.description: Pack detection selects language-specific compile, test, coverage, and lint commands for supported project types.

features.label: Reports and integrations
features.description: Scorecards can be rendered as terminal, HTML, Markdown, JSON, or SARIF output. The MCP server exposes analysis tools.

features.label: Spec review
features.description: An optional OpenAI-compatible review checks requirement coverage and reports possible specification gaps.

features.label: Mutation checks
features.description: The mutation engine changes code in controlled ways and checks whether the project's tests detect those changes.
